The CreateMemo handler in memo_service.go calls DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook.

DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook in server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go calls dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook, which invokes webhook.PostAsync. The delivery package is github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook. HMAC-SHA256 signs requests using Standard Webhooks headers.

**DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; HMAC-SHA256 (Standard Webhooks)**

When a memo is created, `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`:

```156:158:server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
	// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
	if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
		slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
```

`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` is defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. It delegates to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which loads the creator’s webhooks and enqueues delivery via `webhook.PostAsync`:

```14:17:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
// DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook dispatches a webhook when a memo is created.
func (s *APIV1Service) DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx context.Context, memo *v1pb.Memo) error {
	return s.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx, memo, "memos.memo.created")
}
```

```70:71:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
		// Use asynchronous webhook dispatch
		webhook.PostAsync(payload)
```

HTTP delivery is implemented in `internal/webhook` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`). `PostAsync` queues the payload; worker goroutines call `Post`, which sends the POST with `safeClient`.

Signing uses **HMAC-SHA256** in the **Standard Webhooks** format: headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64>`), with the MAC over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body`:

```133:149:internal/webhook/webhook.go
	if requestPayload.SigningSecret != "" {
		key, err := resolveSigningKey(requestPayload.SigningSecret)
		// ...
		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
		mac.Write([]byte(msgID + "." + timestamp + "."))
		mac.Write(body)
		signature := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

		req.Header.Set("webhook-id", msgID)
		req.Header.Set("webhook-timestamp", timestamp)
		req.Header.Set("webhook-signature", "v1,"+signature)
	}
```
